Kill [[Verata the Necromancer|Verata]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Verata in [[Kessex Peak]].
* *BONUS* Kill Verata in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] [[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
See the "Notes" sections of [[Verata the Necromancer#Notes|Verata the Necromancer]] and [[Kessex Peak#Notes|Kessex Peak]].

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Bounty
:''"Kill Verata in Kessex Peak."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
* Verata does not always spawn if [[The Villainy of Galrath]] or its [[The Villainy of Galrath (Hard mode)|hard mode counterpart]] are active.
